overview.description: The TCW Core Plus Bond ETF (FIXT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund is an actively managed ETF that provides broad exposure to various fixed income securities from around the world, issued by both government and corporations. The fund may invest in bonds of any credit quality or maturity. FIXT was launched on Jun 16, 2025 and is issued by TCW.

data.title: TCW Launches $370 Million Core Plus Fixed Income ETF
data.text: LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)--The TCW Group announced that it has completed the conversion of the TCW MetWest Intermediate Bond Fund into a new ETF, the TCW Core Plus Bond ETF.
